crop.notes: Item 'St. Louisans at the Ring Side'.

title.suggested: Allen at Ringside for the McAuliffe-Myer Fight in New Orleans

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, who beat Mike McCool for the American heavyweight title, and Tom Kelly were the best-known St. Louisans at the McAuliffe-Myer fight in New Orleans.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Monday Evening, September 5, 1892.

facts.fact: Allen left St. Louis Saturday night for New Orleans with Charlie Daly's party and arrived Sunday evening
Allen was at ringside for the McAuliffe-Myer fight at the Olympic Athletic Club, New Orleans, named with Tom Kelly as the most noted St. Louisans present; Fred Watkins is called his old backer

notes: Allen is described as having defeated Mike McCool for the American heavyweight championship.
